race.title: Weddings At Fontwell Park Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: WINSTON'S OATH didn't look at home over the fixed-brush obstacles at Southwell 3 weeks ago but that was a pretty strong handicap for the grade and back at the scene of his breakthrough win, he can get back on track. Pippin's Legend and Eyeeye also contested that aforementioned race and showed enough to think they are the main threats. WINSTON'S OATH (IRE) PIPPIN'S LEGEND EYEEYE
race.bettingForecast: Winston's Oath (11/10), Pippin's Legend (11/2), Wistmans Prince (7/1), Beaufort Breeze (8/1), Raging Al (11/1), Eyeeye (12/1), Callero (14/1), Mystical Mabel (20/1), Ephyra (28/1), Dusky Spyglass (150/1)
